subject: Next steps: BlueLeaf deployment — portal activation & ACH/W-9
body:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueleaf.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@blueleaf.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery — BlueLeaf x Redwood next steps

Hi Alex / Samir,

Great to meet earlier — quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and can keep momentum:

- Objective: Replace existing inference stack for conversational support with Redwood Dedicated for predictable latency and per-token cost control.
- Target environment: Production rollout (US-east) for customer support assistants; pilot with ~500k tokens/day expected month 1.
- Must-haves: SOC2 evidence, private VPC option, and procurement paperwork (W-9 + ACH) to complete vendor setup.
- Target start: aiming for first week of June subject to vendor portal activation and final PO.

Next steps I proposed:
1) You confirm the primary procurement contact (procurement@blueleaf.ai is fine) and who will complete ACH + W-9.
2) I’ll hand off to our vendor onboarding (Marissa) to get the portal invite and vendor code set up.
3) We schedule a short kickoff with Eng ops after portal activation (15–30m).

Could you confirm who at BlueLeaf will complete the paperwork and whether the timeline shifted since our call?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if it helps.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueleaf.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — portal activation timing?

Alex — quick follow-up. Haven’t heard back about procurement timing. Is ACH/W-9 still on your side for this week? If priorities shifted I can adjust the kickoff target.

If it’s helpful I can drop the W-9 and ACH instructions into the thread and loop Marissa to trigger the portal invite.

Jasmine

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueleaf.ai>, procurement@blueleaf.ai
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: BlueLeaf procurement — ACH/W-9 attached (RWI-8421)

Marissa / Dylan —

Handoff for vendor setup below. BlueLeaf confirmed the PO commitment verbally during discovery and is targeting early June. Please find the details you’ll need to get them into the vendor portal and assign a vendor code.

Customer details:
- Company: BlueLeaf AI
- Primary contact: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueleaf.ai>
- Procurement contact: procurement@blueleaf.ai
- Portal user to invite: Samir Patel <samir.patel@blueleaf.ai>
- Deal value (initial committed): $48,000 / 12 months
- Target start date: 2027-06-01 (flexible pending portal activation)

Attachments (included):
- Redwood_W-9.pdf (filled)
- ACH_Instructions.xlsx (bank transfer template)

Ask: Can you create the vendor account, send the portal invite to Samir, and confirm whether you need any additional vendor forms? If you could send the portal invite and a note about where to upload the ACH form by EOD Friday that would keep us on track.

I’m available to introduce on a quick handoff call if that helps.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior AE | Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueleaf.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@blueleaf.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Portal invite sent — awaiting ACH confirmation (BlueLeaf / RWI-8421)

Hi Alex / Samir —

Thanks Jasmine for the handoff. Quick update from vendor onboarding: I just sent the vendor portal invite from vendor-portal@redwood.ai to Samir (check spam if it doesn’t show up). The invite includes a secure upload area for the ACH form and W-9.

What we still need from BlueLeaf to finalize activation:
- Complete ACH_Instructions.xlsx in the portal (bank routing + account name).
- Upload completed W-9 (we received the attached copy from Jasmine but legal requires the one uploaded in the portal).
- Confirm billing address and PO number (if issuing a PO).

If you prefer to return the documents via DocuSign instead, here’s a secure upload link: https://redwood.app/portal/invite/RWI-8421 (same invite page). Once we have ACH + W-9 uploaded we’ll assign the vendor code and trigger the trial capacity provisioning (should be within 24 hours of completion).

Small ask: if you can complete the portal upload by Tuesday 10 May we can keep the June 1 kickoff target. If timeline slipped, let us know the new target and we’ll update rollout and resource plans.

Thanks — feel free to reply here or ping me directly and I’ll expedite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0188

---
